Record Class SpatialTableHandle

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.spatial.iceberg.connector.SpatialTableHandle
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.trino.spi.connector.ConnectorTableHandle
public record SpatialTableHandle(io.trino.plugin.iceberg.IcebergTableHandle delegate, io.trino.plugin.iceberg.IcebergColumnHandle geomColumn, List<io.trino.plugin.iceberg.IcebergColumnHandle> bboxLeaves, double rectMinX, double rectMinY, double rectMaxX, double rectMaxY) extends Record implements io.trino.spi.connector.ConnectorTableHandle
A table handle produced by SpatialConnectorMetadata.applyFilter(ConnectorSession, ConnectorTableHandle, Constraint) only when the connector has claimed a rectangle ST_Intersects on a Point geometry column as fully enforced — i.e. it will do the exact filtering itself in BboxFilteringPageSource rather than leave it to the engine. Wraps IcebergTableHandle and carries what the worker needs that the pushed float32 bbox domains cannot convey:
  • geomColumn — the geometry WKB column to materialize for the boundary-shell exact test;
  • the exact query rectangle [minX,maxX] × [minY,maxY] (double precision) — used to build the inward-rounded accept box and to run the shell intersects test. The float32 domains on the handle are outward-rounded and lossy, so the exact rectangle must ride here.

All Trino/Iceberg interaction unwraps this back to delegate() first; a missed unwrap surfaces as a loud ClassCastException, never a silent wrong result.
